title: Settings screen (LLM endpoint, transcription, speakers) with connection test
description: A screen to edit everything in `AppSettings` plus the API key, and to test the LLM endpoint (goals 1, 2, 4).
steps: Create `ui/settings/SettingsViewModel.kt`: constructor `(repo: SettingsRepository, chatClient: ChatClient)`. Holds editable form state `data class SettingsForm(val baseUrl: String, val apiKey: String, val model: String, val maxChars: String, val numThreads: Int, val numSpeakers: Int, val clusterThreshold: Float)` initialised from the repo. `fun update(form)`, `fun save()` (writes via `repo.update` + `repo.setApiKey`; maxChars parsed with `toIntOrNull() ?: current`), `fun testConnection()` which first saves, then calls `chatClient.listModels()` and sets `testResult: String` to `"Connected – N models: a, b, c"` (first 5 ids) or `"Failed: <message>"`; `testing: Boolean` while running.

Create `ui/settings/SettingsScreen.kt` for route `settings` (replace placeholder), in a scrollable `Column` with section headers: **Language model**: Base URL (`OutlinedTextField`, placeholder `http://192.168.1.10:8000/v1`, keyboard type Uri), API key (password visual transformation with a show/hide toggle), Model name, Max transcript characters (number keyboard), button "Test connection" + result text, and if `listModels` returned ids show them as `SuggestionChip`s that fill the Model field when tapped. **Transcription**: Speech engine as a `SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow` "NPU (Nemotron)" / "CPU (Kroko)" bound to `AppSettings.asrEngine` ("npu"/"cpu"), saved immediately, with supporting text "NPU uses the Qualcomm Hexagon processor; CPU is slower to start but works everywhere." and a row "Engine check" navigating to `engine-check`. Threads slider 1..8 (steps 6, label "CPU threads"). Language: a disabled row "English" (French comes in a later task). **Speakers**: Number of speakers dropdown ("Automatic", 2..6), Clustering threshold slider 0.3..0.8 with value shown to 2 decimals and help text "Lower = more speakers". A "Save" button in the top bar; also save on back navigation (`DisposableEffect` onDispose or BackHandler).
acceptanceCriteria: Test: `save()` persists the form (new repository instance reads the same values) and the API key through the SecretStore
Test: `testConnection()` with a fake returning ["m1","m2"] sets testResult `Connected – 2 models: m1, m2`; with a fake throwing LlmException("HTTP 401: x") sets `Failed: HTTP 401: x`
Test: invalid maxChars text keeps the previous value
`source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` exits 0
notes: | Always: run `source scripts/env.sh` before Gradle; the verify command is `source scripts/env.sh && ./gradlew ktlintCheck testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`; run `./gradlew --stop` before ending. Never instantiate `com.k2fsa.sherpa.onnx` engine classes (OnlineRecognizer, OnlineStream, OfflineSpeakerDiarization, SpeakerEmbeddingExtractor, ...) in unit tests; plain `*Config` data classes are fine. Only reference sherpa classes inside package `com.convoscribe.engine.sherpa`. Source root: `app/src/main/java/com/convoscribe/`, tests: `app/src/test/java/com/convoscribe/`.
